scope: Historical synthetic moderation and translation comparison from one Mac. No production accuracy, throughput, or end-to-end posting measurement.

method.moderation: 48 unique synthetic cases repeated twice, plus 28 additional stress cases once. Historical policy and normalization runtime frozen. Same semantic inputs/questions; provider schema adaptation only.
method.execution: Sequential paired calls, alternating provider order and reversing order across repetitions. Fixed shuffled cases. Concurrency 1, no retries; all 294 paired responses valid.
method.latency: Elapsed API call time including network and response body receipt from the same Mac. Not VPS latency, browser rendering time, or posting latency.
method.percentile: Nearest rank: sorted timings at ceil(0.95 * n), using one-based indexing. Median averages the two middle values when n is even.
method.translation: 23 semantic cases (11 expected good, 12 expected issues). Two deterministic placeholder/protected-token failures were excluded before API calls.
method.translationThreshold: Existing rule: any issue flags; all preserve probabilities >= 0.95 pass; otherwise unverified. Held fixed for both providers.
method.moderationAutoAllowThreshold: Verdict allow and reported risk <= 0.05. Label-match counts concern verdicts, not the stricter auto-allow gate.
limitations: Synthetic, previously authored fixtures; labels not independently human reviewed or representative of production.
Existing policy, prompts, rubrics and thresholds came from the Jev workflow. No provider-specific tuning was done, which can favor its existing calibration.
Provider probabilities and confidence are not necessarily calibrated equally; threshold outcomes do not establish relative intelligence.
Repeated requests are not independent new cases. No statistical significance or latency service-level claim.
Private policy, prompts and images are withheld. Public records verify arithmetic, not independent reruns or label adjudication.
Four date-arithmetic cases are retained in the headline totals; an explicitly labeled sensitivity analysis excludes them.
No moderation runtime or deployed provider setting was changed by this evaluation or its publication.

pricing.kind: Estimated input cost at the standard input rates used on the evaluation date; not an account invoice.
pricing.extrapolation: One million checks with the observed average request size. No million-request load test was run.
pricing.exclusions: Downstream Luna/Grok fallbacks, orchestration, infrastructure and any other workflow costs are excluded. This is the initial decision input cost.
pricing.cache: Decisions reported zero cached and cache-write tokens. Jev did not supply equivalent cache detail. Estimates use standard input rates for every input token.

screenshotSmoke.labelSource: Assistant inspection before the request, not independent human labels.
screenshotSmoke.limitation: One easy historical screenshot; capability smoke only, not visual regression accuracy or a Jev comparison.

provenance.identifiers: Case IDs are neutralized and stable within this artifact; private policy text, full prompts, request IDs, local paths and screenshots are omitted.
